knowledge_tree.title: English Compulsory 3
knowledge_tree.content: High school English textbook focusing on themes like festivals, morals, diverse cultures, space exploration, and the value of money.

children.title: Unit 1: Festivals and Celebrations
children.content: Explores global festivals, their origins, customs, and significance.

children.title: Festival Origins
children.content: Festivals originate from seasons, religions, famous figures, and important events.

children.title: Harvest Festivals
children.content: Celebrated worldwide to show gratitude for food supply, e.g., Mid-Autumn Festival in China.

children.title: Changing Customs
children.content: Customs evolve over time due to modernization, e.g., firecrackers banned in cities for pollution.

children.title: Commercialization of Festivals
children.content: Festivals becoming more commercial with increased spending on gifts.

children.title: Lantern Festival
children.content: Chinese festival with lantern displays, riddles, and yuanxiao eating.

children.title: Unit 2: Morals and Virtues
children.content: Discusses moral dilemmas, virtues, and ethical decision-making through stories.

children.title: Moral Dilemmas
children.content: Situations requiring difficult choices between conflicting values.

children.title: Dr. Lin Qiaozhi's Life
children.content: First Chinese female OB-GYN, known for compassion and dedication.

children.title: Virtues
children.content: Qualities like kindness, honesty, and responsibility admired across cultures.

children.title: The Stone in the Road
children.content: Fable teaching responsibility and proactive problem-solving.

children.title: Unit 3: Diverse Cultures
children.content: Examines cultural diversity, immigration, and cultural symbols.

children.title: Cultural Diversity in the US
children.content: Influences from Native Americans, immigrants, and ethnic groups.

children.title: Chinatown in San Francisco
children.content: Oldest and largest Chinatown in the US, a center for Chinese culture.

children.title: Ethnic Minority Cultures in China
children.content: Rich traditions of groups like Zhuang, with unique festivals and customs.

children.title: American Food Origins
children.content: Foods like hamburgers, nachos, and gumbo reflect diverse cultural influences.

children.title: Unit 4: Space Exploration
children.content: Covers the history, challenges, and benefits of space exploration.

children.title: History of Space Exploration
children.content: Key events: Sputnik 1, Yuri Gagarin's flight, Apollo 11 moon landing.

children.title: Challenges of Space Travel
children.content: Risks include launch failures, space debris, and long-term health effects.

children.title: Benefits of Space Exploration
children.content: Technological advancements, scientific discoveries, and inspiring innovation.

children.title: China's Space Program
children.content: Achievements like Shenzhou missions, Tiangong Space Station, and Mars exploration.

children.title: Unit 5: The Value of Money
children.content: Discusses attitudes towards money, wealth, and ethical financial behavior.

children.title: The Million Pound Bank Note
children.content: Story by Mark Twain exploring how wealth affects perception and treatment.

children.title: Moral Implications of Money
children.content: Discusses honesty, generosity, and the dangers of greed.

children.title: Real-Life Examples
children.content: Stories like Chen Liyan returning lost money, highlighting integrity.

children.title: Grammar and Language
children.content: Key grammar points and language functions covered in the textbook.

children.title: -ing Form as Attribute and Predicative
children.content: Using -ing forms to describe nouns and as subject complements.

children.title: Ellipsis
children.content: Omitting words to avoid repetition in conversations and writing.

children.title: Modal Verbs
children.content: Expressing ability, permission, obligation, and possibility.

children.title: Past Future Tense
children.content: Describing future events from a past perspective.
